title: Geodesic-SVDD Latent Mixup for One-Shot Distributed Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.33619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federated healthcare diagnostics. While Gradient Boosted Decision Trees are widely used in centralized settings due to their efficiency, they are incompatible with standard gradient-based federated learning protocols because of their non-differentiability. Conversely, standard deep classifiers that are amenable to federated optimization often suffer from catastrophic forgetting under label distribution skew. In this work, to address these gaps we propose Geodesic-SVDD, a framework for Distributed Spherical Prototype Learning that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere, so that local models can be aggregated as probabilistic manifolds in a single round. translated_title: 面向单轮分布式表格学习的测地线-SVDD潜空间混合方法
translated_abstract: 在结构化数据上进行分布式学习是隐私敏感领域中一种关键且被广泛采用的方法，应用范围涵盖金融反欺诈到联邦医疗诊断等场景。尽管梯度提升决策树（GBDT）因其高效性在集中式场景中被广泛使用，但由于其不可微性，它与标准的基于梯度的联邦学习协议并不兼容。相反，适用于联邦优化的标准深度分类器在标签分布偏斜的情况下往往遭受灾难性遗忘问题。在本工作中，为弥合这些差距，我们提出了Geodesic-SVDD，一个分布式球面原型学习框架，它将每个客户端的任务重新表述为超球面上的单类密度估计，使得各本地模型能够在单轮通信中作为概率流形进行聚合。具体而言，对于每个客户端，我们采用残差球面编码器与测地线潜空间混合方法……
tldr: 提出Geodesic-SVDD分布式球面原型学习框架，将客户端任务转化为超球面上的单类密度估计，并结合残差球面编码器与测地线潜空间混合，实现表格数据在单轮通信下的分布式模型聚合，同时克服了GBDT不可微与深度分类器灾难性遗忘的缺陷。
en_tdlr: Proposes Geodesic-SVDD, a distributed spherical prototype learning framework that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere with a residual spherical encoder and geodesic latent mixup, enabling one-shot aggregation of local models for tabular learning while overcoming GBDT non-differentiability and catastrophic forgetting in deep classifiers.
